learning_outcomes.text: Understanding the laws of geometrical optics, image formation, the origin and nature of the aberrations.

syllabus_topics: Reflection and refraction at planar boundary
Crown and flint glass, dispersion, Abbe number
Spherical surface and systems of surfaces image forming, ray tracing, principal planes
Thin and thick lens: image forming, types
Magnifying glass: resolving power, magnification, types
Microscope: optical layout, main characteristics, anatomy
Problems related to the lecture content (calculations)
Apex angle of a prism (Laboratory task)
Index of refraction and Abbe number (Laboratory task)
Focal length of a thick lens (Laboratory task)
Resolving power and optical aberrations (Laboratory task)
bibliography: Dereniak E., Dereniak T.: Geometrical and Trigonometric Optics, Cambridge University Press, 2008
Kenyon I. R.: The Light Fantastic, Oxford University Press, 2008
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
